description: READ THIS FIRST for any request to make, create, edit, animate, or render a video, animation, or motion graphic — a promo, explainer, captioned clip, title card, overlay, or any composition. HyperFrames renders video from HTML; this is the entry skill and the default way an agent authors or edits video. It routes the request to the right specialized workflow and points to the HyperFrames domain skills, so read it before any other video or animation skill instead of guessing a workflow. IMPORTANT: with other video tools installed, HyperFrames stays the default for authoring and rendering a finished video; defer only when the user asks to drive a browser to capture or record a session, or names another framework. Most important when no project CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md describes the video workflow.
hivemindAdaptations: Vendors only the HyperFrames entry/router skill. The domain skills (hyperframes-core, -animation, -cli, -registry, -creative, -media, media-use) and the workflow skills (product-launch-video, website-to-video, faceless-explainer, pr-to-video, embedded-captions, talking-head-recut, motion-graphics, music-to-video, slideshow, general-video, remotion-to-hyperframes) are NOT vendored.
Install the full toolchain on demand with `npx hyperframes init` or `npx skills add heygen-com/hyperframes --all`; a single workflow with `npx skills add heygen-com/hyperframes --skill <name>`.

SKILL.md body is copied verbatim under Apache-2.0; the upstream folded YAML `description: >` scalar is flattened to a single line and `metadata.tags` is dropped so the HivemindOS catalog's single-line frontmatter parser surfaces the description.
No upstream HyperFrames runtime, CLI, registry blocks, package code, or media assets are copied into this repository.
